question: Let \(x=-2016.\) What is the value of \[\Bigg\vert\Big\vert |x|-x\Big\vert-|x|\Bigg\vert-x?\]
solution:
Start with the innermost absolute value. Because \(x=-2016\), we have \(|x|=2016\), and therefore
\[
\bigl||x|-x\bigr|
=|2016-(-2016)|=4032.
\]
Now use this result in the outer absolute value, remembering that the final \(-x\) lies outside it:
\[
\left|\bigl||x|-x\bigr|-|x|\right|-x
=|4032-2016|-(-2016)
=2016+2016=4032.
\]
The value is \(4032\), choice \(\mathrm{D}\).
